tweets.text: I offer my congratulations and condolences on the martyrdom of the courageous commander Tangsiri to his esteemed family and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. I pray Almighty God will raise this martyr to the highest ranks [in the Hereafter].
God willing, the martyrdom of Admiral Tangsiri will enable the country to continue along the path of Iran’s maritime authority and resistance with even greater strength and firmness than before.

The martyrdom of this Iranian soldier and a guardian of Islam in the course of the epic Third Imposed War is a great source of pride for the Iranian nation who have always been protectors of Iran’s independence and its maritime borders, particularly the Persian Gulf.
The valiant, courageous commander of the Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, Admiral Alireza Tangsiri, has been adorned with the rank of martyrdom after years of devoted struggle.

In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

“And do not think of those who are slain on the path of Allah to be dead; rather, they are alive, being provided for near their Lord” (Quran 3:169).
